newsitem.title: USA: Potlatch wins $95 million in jury case.
newsitem.headline: Potlatch wins $95 million in jury case.

text.p: Potlatch Corp said Tuesday that a jury in the State of Idaho's District Court had awarded it $95 million in damages for what it said were defects and deficiencies associated with a pulp washer system installed in its Lewiston, Idaho, pulp mill.
Potlatch said in a statement Tuesday evening that the washers were supplied by Beloit Corp, the defendant in the case.
No one at Beloit Corp's offices in Wisconsin was immediately available for comment Tuesday evening.
A Potlatch spokeswoman said the award would have no effect on the company's second quarter earnings.
Potlatch, which filed its initial complaint against Beloit in December 1995, said the jury award is subject to post-trial motions and to appeal to the Idaho Supreme Court.
"Any award will be booked when this process is exhausted," Potlatch spokeswoman Diane Olberg said.
